This image is a template for 7 parallax backdrop layers of DAWNHARBOR, a white-walled port town at sunrise, in my game's style: soft painted pixel art, warm gold light, plum-violet shade. 4. CLOUDS: 4 separate soft morning clouds, cream with peach undersides, on magenta.
5. LANDMARK: a tall white lighthouse on a rocky point with a sun-shaped lamp, on magenta.
6. SKY BODY: a low warm morning sun with a soft glow ring, on magenta.
7. MOTES: a scatter of sparkles like sun on water and a few distant gulls, on magenta.
